_doc: Reference data for benchmarking the Castor pipeline against an SMB HRIS / payroll B2B SaaS venture.

venture_under_test.name: Workhive
venture_under_test.description: Workhive is a B2B SaaS HRIS and payroll platform for SMBs with 10-200 employees. We bundle payroll, benefits administration, time tracking, and onboarding in one product priced at $40/month base + $8/employee/month. Target buyer: founder-CEOs and Office Managers at SMBs without a dedicated HR function. We compete with Gusto, Rippling, BambooHR, Justworks, and ADP RUN. Differentiation: AI-driven onboarding flows, one-click multi-state tax registration, and a transparent flat-rate pricing model versus competitors' opaque per-feature add-ons.
venture_under_test.category: B2B SaaS HRIS / payroll for SMB
